Next, dense_captioner at 10.5s-11.0s says "The top wooden piece is slightly rotated" and the puzzle is being manipulated; among the listed choices, that most directly matches (B) rotate the right diamond gently. The same 10.5s-11.0s caption also says the other piece is "adjusted," which is the closest tool-grounded support for (A) push the right diamond slightly forward, but the caption does not explicitly say "forward," so this part remains approximate.

Then dense_captioner at 11.0s-11.5s reports the top piece is "pulled slightly upward" while the bottom piece is pulled downward, showing a stronger reorientation move after the gentle rotation/adjustment; among the remaining options, this is the closest available evidence for (C) twist the right diamond shaped ring 90 degrees, though the tool does not explicitly confirm the angle "90 degrees."

So the best tool-grounded order is D -> B -> A -> C, with D from 10.0s-10.5s, B/A from 10.5s-11.0s, and C approximated from the later 11.0s-11.5s reorientation. That sequence corresponds to option B, DABC.
